records.title: Maintenance of NH-27 in Bihar
details: a to e: Currently, initial rectification has been taken up in some critical sections to keep the road in traffic worthy condition. For improving the riding quality, overlay/renewal is proposed on the entire section in a phased manner within the scope of PBMC Contractor. Further, construction of a Bridge over River Gandak is under implementation causing inconvenience in seamless movement of traffic. All efforts are being made for early completion of the bridge.

records.title: Narayani River Front Waterways
details: d: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) an autonomous organisation under Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways has initiated hydro graphic survey to assess the Navigational depth and for providing floating jetties along the National Waters 37 (NW-37)

records.title: Development of Narayani River Front
details: d to e: With regard to the navigation issue below the Rewa Ghat Bridge Nationl Highway Authority of India (NHAI) has been requested to construct new bridge with appropriate vertical & horizontal navigational clearance.
